Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking time today — solid conversation. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can get an accurate Dedicated capacity quote over to you: 

Summary from our call
- Primary workload: large-scale chat assistant for financial analysts (retrieval + generation).
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~100–150M tokens/month in Q1 post-launch.
- Peak days: ~2–3M tokens/day during earnings weeks.
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for streaming responses for 512-token prompts.
- Current preferred model family: Llama-3 / MPT-style open models (you mentioned trying a mid-sized variant).

Pricing / capacity inputs we need (short answers are fine):
1) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens for the infra portion (we often model $/1M tokens for dedicated capacity to compare against hosted API)?
2) Budget range for infra (monthly committed spend) — ballpark is fine.
3) GPU preference for Dedicated (A100-80GB vs H100) — you mentioned H100 as preferred but wanted to confirm.
4) Reserved capacity size thinking (number of GPUs or vGPU-equivalents).
5) Throughput targets in tokens/sec or concurrent reqs (if you measure in QPS or tokens/sec).

Attachments: I’m attaching the MAP draft we discussed (FinLytics-MAP-draft.pdf) and will follow up with a preliminary quote once I have the answers above.

Next steps
- Emily: quick reply with the 5 items above (even ballpark numbers).
- Marcus: we may schedule a short SE deep-dive (30–45m) to validate throughput and model choice once Emily confirms model/throughput.
- I’ll put together 2 pricing options: 4xH100 reserved and 8xA100 baseline so you can see unit economics side-by-side.

Thanks — speak soon.

Best,

Marissa — thanks, and appreciate the clear follow-up. Here are the answers from our side after syncing with engineering and finance: 

1) Target $/1M tokens: we’d like to see dedicated infra around ~$800–1,200 per 1M tokens (that’s what our finance team modeled to hit our product margin targets).
2) Budget range (monthly committed): roughly $20k–35k/month for infra to start (we can increase after launch).
3) GPU preference: H100 preferred for perf and NVL support, but we can consider A100 if the delta is material vs cost.
4) Reserved capacity size: initial ask is 4 GPUs reserved (able to burst to 6–8 if needed).
5) Throughput targets: target aggregate throughput ~2,000–2,500 tokens/sec sustained; peak burst up to ~6,000 tokens/sec for short windows. Latency target p95 < 200ms.

Notes:
- Model: we’ll likely land on an optimized 34B variant; SE team should validate memory/kv-cache sizing.
- Token mix: we expect an average response length of 120 tokens and prompts around 50 tokens; that’s where the 100–150M/month comes from.

If you can send a side-by-side quote for 4xH100 reserved and an 8xA100 alternative with unit economics shown as $/1M tokens, we’ll review with finance this week. Happy to set the SE call — Rajiv will coordinate schedules.

Thanks,
Emily
CTO, FinLytics
emily.cho@finlytics.com
